nodes.label: Form Components overview (10 anonymous Blade components)
nodes.norm_label: form components overview (10 anonymous blade components)

nodes.label: Select: Multi-select
nodes.rationale: Multi-select uses wire:ignore to prevent Livewire morphs from interfering with the dropdown state; values sync client->server via $wire.$set(), and server->client updates (e.g. $this->reset()) are handled via $wire.$watch().

nodes.label: Select: Async Remote Search
nodes.rationale: Requests are debounced and use AbortController to cancel previous in-flight requests, avoiding race conditions on fast typing.

nodes.label: Textarea: Auto Resize
nodes.rationale: Uses Alpine with reactive x-bind:style (instead of imperative DOM height writes) so the grow behavior survives Livewire morphs.

nodes.label: Toggle
nodes.rationale: A single native <input type=checkbox role=switch> (sr-only peer) drives everything so wire:model/form submission keep working; aria-checked must NOT be added per ARIA-in-HTML because it would be redundant and could desync from wire:model.

nodes.label: Upload: Auto Upload / Staging
nodes.rationale: When autoUpload=false, two <input type=file> are rendered (a visible one without wire:model, a hidden one with wire:model used only by uploadPending()) specifically to prevent Livewire from auto-uploading on the change event.

nodes.label: Upload: Speed & ETA
nodes.rationale: Speed is smoothed using an Exponential Moving Average (alpha=0.3) specifically to avoid jittery speed/ETA numbers between progress ticks.

nodes.label: @koreScripts directive
nodes.rationale: @koreScripts must come before @livewireScripts because Livewire initializes Alpine.js and dispatches alpine:init -- kore-ui plugins must be registered at that exact moment.

nodes.label: The `transitioning` Lock
nodes.rationale: transitioning=true during the 300ms stacking transition so calls to activate() during that window are ignored, preventing rapid-fire kore:open events from corrupting stack state or causing visual glitches.

nodes.label: Focus Trapping (x-trap.noscroll.inert)
nodes.rationale: x-trap.noscroll.inert traps keyboard focus within the active overlay, prevents scroll on the trapped area, and applies inert outside it; active only for the current overlay.

nodes.label: kore:before-close event
nodes.rationale: Dispatched client-side by the Alpine component via Livewire.dispatchTo(); cancellation (params.closing=false) must happen synchronously in JS via @script/$wire.on() -- a PHP #[On('kore:before-close')] listener cannot cancel the close because it isn't synchronous.

nodes.label: Overlay Attribute Priority Chain
nodes.rationale: config defaults -> component static methods -> overlayAttributes (call-site). Each level overrides the previous; overriding type/position/size auto-recomputes derived attributes (animation, containerClass, sizeClass), but explicit overrides of the derived attributes still win.

nodes.label: Spotlight Fuzzy Search
nodes.rationale: Custom ~35-line fuzzy search weights name=3, synonyms=2, description=1 with bonuses for consecutive characters and start-of-string matches; deemed sufficient for most use cases. For datasets >200 items, Fuse.js can be integrated manually via Alpine.data instead.

nodes.label: SpotlightItem ID generation (Str::slug)
nodes.rationale: ID generated via Str::slug($name) so it is stable across sessions, letting localStorage history match it. Items sharing a name share an ID, so the second overwrites the first's history unless names are unique or the ID is overridden via subclassing.

nodes.label: SpotlightProvider::search()
nodes.rationale: items() loads on mount and is filtered client-side by Alpine's fuzzy search; search() is called with debounce via $wire and exists specifically for heavy database queries that shouldn't run client-side.

nodes.label: Theme localStorage Persistence
nodes.rationale: All localStorage access is wrapped in try/catch for compatibility with restrictive incognito modes or disabled storage; only mode (not resolved) is persisted, invalid/missing values default to 'system'.

nodes.label: Theme DOM Effects (.dark + data-theme)
nodes.rationale: Both the .dark class and data-theme attribute are applied to <html> because kore-theme.css targets `.dark, [data-theme=dark]`: the class enables Tailwind's dark: variant while the attribute enables plain CSS selector targeting.

nodes.label: wire:navigate Compatibility
nodes.rationale: Livewire 4's wire:navigate morphs the DOM without destroying Alpine, but the morph can strip the .dark class/data-theme attribute from <html>. The store registers a livewire:navigated listener during init() that re-applies the theme after each navigation, requiring no extra configuration.

nodes.label: KoreTheme Alpine Store
nodes.rationale: Re-applies theme classes after the 'livewire:navigated' event because wire:navigate morphs <html> and strips the .dark class / data-theme attribute previously set by _apply().

nodes.label: Pinned Column Offset Correction
nodes.rationale: PHP sets initial pinned-column offsets assuming a fixed width; recalcPinnedOffsets measures the actual rendered header cell widths and corrects the sticky left/right offsets so multiple pinned columns line up exactly.

nodes.label: Checkbox Indeterminate Morph State Fix
nodes.rationale: Selection checkboxes are plain inputs without wire:model, so Livewire's morph updates the checked/indeterminate DOM attributes but not the live DOM properties. A reused header/row element would keep stale visual state (e.g. 'select all' staying checked on a page with no selected rows). syncSelectionCheckboxes re-asserts server truth from data-checked/data-indeterminate after every morph, since 'indeterminate' has no HTML attribute at all.

nodes.label: Single Global Livewire Morph Hook
nodes.rationale: A single global Livewire.hook('morphed', ...) is registered once (guarded by pinnedMorphHookRegistered) instead of one per component instance, so pinned offsets and indeterminate checkboxes are recomputed after every morph without duplicate handlers; the callback is wrapped in try/catch so a thrown error never breaks Livewire's morph cycle or freezes wire:loading.

nodes.label: Toast Double-Fire Navigation Guard
nodes.rationale: A skipNext flag skips the first 'livewire:navigated' flash check when the initial flashed toast was already added during init(), preventing the same session-flashed toast from being shown twice (double toast bug) across a wire:navigate SPA transition.

nodes.label: Teleport Inert Guard
nodes.rationale: x-trap.inert marks every new body child as inert via a MutationObserver, which incorrectly catches elements teleported with x-teleport="body" even though they are semantically part of overlay content. A MutationObserver per [data-kore-teleport] element strips 'inert' back off, and a capture-phase 'focusin' listener (registered before overlay open, so it fires before focus-trap's own capture listener) stops propagation so focus-trap does not snap focus away from teleported elements.

nodes.label: Spotlight Fuzzy Search Ranking Design
nodes.rationale: fuzzyMatch first tries a cheap substring match (scored by pattern length) and falls back to a subsequence scan that rewards consecutive matching characters and a matching first character; searchItems then applies field weighting (name x3, synonyms x2, description x1) so more relevant fields dominate the ranking of spotlight results.

nodes.label: Array Field Sync via $wire.$set
nodes.rationale: Hidden <input> values can only hold strings, but multi-select, range, and tag-input models are arrays that Livewire expects natively. Instead of serializing to the hidden input, these components resolve the wire:model attribute name and call this.$wire.$set(modelName, array) directly, bypassing native form serialization for array-typed bindings.

nodes.label: Base Filtered Query Pattern
nodes.rationale: A host-defined query builder (baseFilteredQuery, presumably combining WithFiltering::applyFilters + WithSearch::applySearch) is shared by WithExport::exportAs() and WithBulkActions::getAllMatchingIds() so that CSV export and 'select all matching' bulk actions both operate over the full filtered/searched dataset instead of just the current paginated page.

nodes.label: AVG Aggregation Null Safety on Empty Dataset
nodes.norm_label: avg aggregation null safety on empty dataset

nodes.label: perPage Coercion to Prevent Memory Blow-ups
nodes.norm_label: perpage coercion to prevent memory blow-ups

nodes.label: mount() Must Not Overwrite BaseUrl-Restored perPage
nodes.norm_label: mount() must not overwrite baseurl-restored perpage

nodes.label: URL scheme sanitization / open-redirect defense
nodes.rationale: Sanitizes URLs before rendering them in href attributes: allows http/https absolute URLs and relative paths/queries/anchors, but blocks the javascript: and data: schemes and scheme-relative ('//host') URLs to prevent XSS and open-redirect attacks. Also strips control characters (tabs/newlines) that browsers ignore but that can be used to smuggle a dangerous scheme, e.g. 'java\tscript:alert(1)'.

nodes.label: Confirm-callback forgery-resistant authorization
nodes.rationale: The kore:confirm-callback Livewire event is dispatchable directly from the browser and could be forged with an arbitrary method name. To prevent a forged event from invoking an unauthorized or protected method (e.g. bypassing a confirm dialog to call a protected bulk-action method like a DataTable's runBulkAction), only methods explicitly authorized server-side via confirm()->send() are allowed to run. The authorization is single-use/consumed, so replaying the same callback event is a no-op.

nodes.label: WCAG field accessibility pattern (aria-describedby / aria-invalid)
nodes.rationale: WCAG 3.3.1 (Error Identification) and 4.1.2 (Name, Role, Value) require form controls to associate their hint/error text with the control via aria-describedby and to signal validity via aria-invalid. KoreUi's shared field template exposes deterministic ids ({fieldId}-error / {fieldId}-hint / {fieldId}-description), and each form control component (input, textarea, password, number, maskable, checkbox, toggle, radio, radio-group) references them consistently.

nodes.label: InvalidOverlay Fixture
nodes.rationale: Deliberately does NOT implement Overlayable; used to verify that OverlayManager's resolver rejects components lacking the contract, throwing InvalidArgumentException.

nodes.label: Pest Bootstrap Config
nodes.rationale: uses(TestCase::class)->in(__DIR__) binds every test file under tests/ to the shared Orchestra Testbench TestCase, giving all suites access to the KoreUi service provider, Livewire, and Blade icon providers without per-file boilerplate.

nodes.label: Kore ThemeSwitch Component
nodes.rationale: @koreThemeScript renders a bootstrap <script> that reads localStorage 'kore-theme' and toggles the .dark class before Alpine hydrates, avoiding a flash of the wrong theme on load.

nodes.label: S1: Locked $providers Property Guard
nodes.rationale: $providers is public mount input on SpotlightManager. Without #[Locked], a client could set it to an arbitrary class name; getItems()/search() resolve entries via app($class), which would instantiate any class. Locking the property and validating that resolved classes extend SpotlightProvider closes this hole.

nodes.label: S2: searchDependency SSRF Guard
nodes.rationale: searchDependency() performs Http::get() against a URL taken from the client-supplied dependency payload. Without host validation this is an SSRF vector reaching cloud metadata endpoints (169.254.169.254) or internal/loopback services (127.0.0.1, 10.0.0.0/8). The guard blocks link-local, private, and loopback hosts while allowing public hosts.

nodes.label: S4: url Action Scheme Neutralization
nodes.rationale: The 'url' action type is navigated client-side via window.location.href. A javascript: or data: scheme would execute script. actionTarget is neutralized to null for such schemes, both for author-defined SpotlightItem::url() calls and for untrusted SpotlightResult payloads hydrated from a remote search endpoint.
